text:
No, the tool output doesn't show Sentinel-2 being used. The 2022 loss was mapped from Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13), which uses 30 m pixels. It was checked against the JRC GFC2020 forest map (10 m) and the MGAP 2021 forest map. The output doesn't say which sensors underlie these products, so I can't confirm or rule out Sentinel-2 as an input.

What the evidence does show:
- About 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022, or 3.41% of the 17.6 ha asset.
- The loss was corroborated: a later year was observed, and JRC 2020 shows forest over 100% of the event area.
- MGAP 2021 classifies 0.5 ha of the event area as native forest and 0.1 ha as outside mapped forest.
- A further 0.2 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event.

This doesn't establish deforestation, cause, legality, actor, or compliance.
